title: Canadian Tagine Stuffed Yellow Peppers
description: A flavorful and healthy vegetarian dish, where bell peppers are stuffed with a mixture of quinoa, vegetables, and spices, cooked in a tagine.
instructions: Cut the tops off the peppers and remove seeds and membranes.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, cooked onion mixture, and chopped seeds.
Stuff each pepper with the quinoa mixture and place in a baking dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, until the peppers are tender.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
